title: Grateful Dead Live at Hollywood Palladium on 1971-08-05
lineage: CD -> Cool Edit Pro v2.0 -> Samplitude Professional v9.12 -> FLAC
source: (FOB) Sony ECM-22P -> Master Reel -> Reel -> Dat -> Cool Edit Pro -> CD D

ai_review.summary: A lively Palladium show captured on audience tape with even, punchy levels, though it suffers from a glitch and missing tracks.
ai_review.review: The recording delivers a raw, high‑energy performance that many fans describe as outstanding, especially after Charlie Miller’s mastering which adds clarity and punch. However, listeners note a noticeable glitch at the start of “Me & My Uncle” and the complete absence of “Not Fade Away” and “Bird Song,” which detracts from an otherwise solid AUD source.

ai_rating.rationale: Positive comments about performance and mastering balance negative remarks about technical glitches and missing songs; the average of the four star ratings (5,4,2,0) yields a modest overall score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Even levels with added punch from Miller's mastering; a glitch at ~00:21 in “Me & My Uncle”; both audience and soundboard versions missing “Not Fade Away” and “Bird Song.”

show_quality.setlist_flow: Two sets feel like they may come from different sources, but the overall flow is raw and energetic.
